latest_substantive_result.summary: The producer reports a finite-cadence paired-recovery bound for the averaged recovered logical channel in a specified sensor-plus-tag code, while explicitly correcting the boundary for retained syndrome records. The source's quadratic misalignment guarantee applies only after syndrome erasure; finite cadence attenuates the reference. It also rejects the proposed scalar-learning advantage against a conventional sign-reversed control. A separate public count-only source-calibration fixture reached a source-reported finite precision gate in one synthetic realization. No target benchmark, physical experiment, practical advantage or novelty claim is established.
